title: P2LRN Accessibility Profile
description: Describes accessible representations and relationships without duplicating the accessibility semantics of QTI, HTML/ARIA or source standards.
rules: Accessible alternatives SHOULD be modeled as representations of the same Resource when they are semantically equivalent.
P2LRN MUST preserve accessibility metadata supplied by an authoritative embedded profile such as QTI.
The target for native web content is WCAG 2.2 AA, but P2LRN packaging alone does not certify conformance.
